bio.text: Teresa Fox, a Republican from Bremerton, advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary for Washington's 6th Congressional District and will face Democratic incumbent Emily Randall in the November general election.

According to the Bainbridge Island Review's July 2026 candidate summary, Fox received an associate's degree from Olympic College, worked for the college as an environmental health and safety director, and worked as a regional safety and health coordinator with the state Department of Labor and Industries.
